tag_version_contract.rule: The workflow must run from refs/tags/<tag> and the v-prefixed tag must match pyproject project.version.

publication_guard.release_event: requires successful tagged build and exact tag/version match
publication_guard.manual_dispatch: requires confirm_publish=true and a tagged ref
publication_guard.duplicate_attempt: PyPI rejects an already-uploaded version explicitly; no skip-existing behavior is enabled
publication_guard.concurrency: not configured; an Owner must avoid concurrent retries for the same tag

credentials.oidc: not configured; future Trusted Publishing migration remains a separate task
